title: Classification of spherical metrics on tori with four singularities, I: half periods
summary: Classifying the spherical metrics on a torus $E_τ$ with $4π$ conic angle at each half period point\, ${ω_k}/{2}, k=0,1,2,3$\, is equivalent to classify solutions of the following curvature equation \begin{align}\label{eq0731093154} Δu+e^u=4π\sum_{k=0}^3δ_{\frac{ω_k}{2}}\text{\ on\ }E_τ\end{align} where $τ\in \mathbb{H}:=\{z\in \mathbb{C}\mid \mathrm{Im} \, z>0\}$ and $δ_p$ is the Dirac measure at $p\in E_τ$.
